snippet.title: Tales of Orrin - Raw Uncut Gameplay EP 3 (Alpha 0.4.8)
snippet.description:
Raw, uncut gameplay from Tales of Orrin, a classic-style fantasy MMORPG in early alpha. No edits, no cuts: 20 minutes of exploring, questing and fighting, just as it plays today.

Tales of Orrin is being built from the ground up with its own game client, its own world and its own classes. Everything you see is a work in progress and changes with every alpha update.

🎮 Want to play?
The alpha is free. Join the Discord, say hi, and we'll get you an invite.
 https://discord.gg/hFqAhBGJxU

💬 On the Discord you'll find:
• Alpha access and patch notes
• Class and spec discussions, help shape the classes
• Bug reports and feedback straight to the developer

#TalesOfOrrin #MMORPG #IndieGame #Gameplay #Alpha
